Yesterday was a rest day with 7,151 steps keeping you ticking over, and your body burned 2,538 kcal — solid baseline metabolism at 91.4kg. No training logged, which is fine, but that 4.5 hours of sleep is the real story here and it shows up everywhere.

Your HRV dropped to 65ms against your 97-120ms baseline — that's a significant red flag. Stress at 43/100 isn't alarming, but combined with that sleep debt, your nervous system is genuinely underprepared today. Keep any planned session easy — a gentle 20-30 minute jog at most, nothing intense.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything else. Aim for 8 hours — one good night won't fix the deficit, but it starts the recovery. Hit your 175g protein today; with poor sleep, muscle breakdown increases, so nutrition discipline matters even more right now. You've got 166 days — protect them.
